shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat surface
bird imagery (bird-headed figure in B; small bird-like signs among the script in A)
horizontal register/band organization (rows of signs in A; inscribed band along top of B)
justification: A is entirely a dense field of small pictographic signs in horizontal rows with no dominant figure, while B is a single large bird-headed winged figure in profile filling the panel, with only a narrow line of signs along its upper edge; the only real correspondences are the shared use of low-relief profile forms, small bird-shaped signs, and a horizontal band of script. The relationships and arrangement differ fundamentally: repeated text registers versus one monumental figure with wings, arm and elaborate curled hair/feather detail dominating the field.
